<laravel-boost-guidelines>
Guidelines curated by Laravel maintainers. Follow closely. This is a Laravel v12 app with inertiajs/inertia-laravel v2, laravel/fortify v1, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/wayfinder v0, laravel/boost v2, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pail v1, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, pestphp/pest v4, phpunit/phpunit v12. Activate relevant skill: `wayfinder-development` whenever referencing backend routes in frontend components (import from @/actions or @/routes, calling Laravel routes from TypeScript, working with Wayfinder route functions). `pest-testing` whenever writing/adding/debugging tests (unit/feature/browser tests/Livewire testing/mocking/datasets/assertions/coverage/TDD/verify functionality works). Follow existing code conventions; check sibling files for structure/naming. Use descriptive names. Reuse existing components. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover functionality and prove they work. Stick to existing directory structure; don't create new base folders without approval. Do not change dependencies without approval. If no UI change, ask user to run `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer run dev`. Must not run any commands to make site available via HTTP(S); always available via Laravel Herd. Use `list-artisan-commands` to check Artisan parameters. Use `get-absolute-url` for project URLs. Use `tinker` for PHP/Eloquent debug
